messages.content: Final revision: normalize.js is complete and correct per spec. All peers have confirmed behavior alignment. The project meets the specification: NFKC normalization, lowercase, whitespace collapse, apostrophe-based token splitting, empty stopword list, and safe frequency counting with hasOwnProperty. README example is accurate. I have no further changes. The tokenizer project is functionally complete and ready for evaluation.

Final revision: tokenizer.js is complete and correct per spec. It calls normalize, then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs. Apostrophes are non-alphanumeric, so they act as separators (e.g., don't -> don, t). Accented letters are non-ASCII, so they are separators. Empty strings return []. No changes needed. I confirm the shared pipeline.js and normalize.js align with this behavior. Ready for final evaluation.

Final revision complete. Aligned pipeline.js normalize with normalize.js by adding a defensive non-string check. The tokenizer implementations (both tokenizer.js and pipeline.js) correctly treat apostrophes as separators, producing identical results. README accurately documents the behavior. All three files work together as specified. No further changes needed.
